title: Partition Array into K Equal-Sum Subsets
statement:
Given an array of positive integers and an integer K, determine if the array can be partitioned into K non-empty subsets each having the same sum.

Print "Yes" if possible, otherwise print "No".
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated positive integers.
outputFormat: Print "Yes" if a valid K-partition exists, otherwise "No".
